description:
## Problem
Before `benchbox submit` can direct contributors to `develop`, `develop` needs fork-safe bundle validation, a mechanical manual-review / no-auto-merge guard (because merging to `develop` immediately triggers `site-inputs.yml` and live Explorer deployment), and clean CI path isolation so `publication/ledger-seed.json` does not trigger medium/correctness code lanes.

## Change (Step 2 of 6)
1. Trigger `.github/workflows/validate-submission.yml` (`pull_request_target`) on `develop` gated by `paths: ["results-data/bundles/**"]`, checking out only trusted `develop` base validator code and enforcing the data-only rule before touching any PR file.
2. Mechanically block auto-merge for external bundle submissions (e.g., auto-apply `no-auto-merge` enforced by `hold`, plus `pr-arm` refusal).
3. Verify how `develop`'s required ruleset checks (`core`, `docs`, `explorer`, `results-data`, `hold`, `review-gate`, `release-v2 probe`) behave on a `results-data/**`-only fork PR so it gets green required statuses without running heavy code tests or stalling on secret-scoped jobs.
4. Stop `publication/ledger-seed.json` from triggering heavy code-test lanes in `.github/ci-units.yml`.
5. Rewrite `publication/ledger-seed.json` and `scripts/publication/create_ledger_seed.py` as accepted and withdrawn entries cut from `develop` (dropping `published_only` and `legacy_overlay`).
6. Rewrite `tests/unit/docs/test_publication_architecture.py` to name `develop` as the archive while preserving all surviving invariants (acceptance != publication, manual review / no auto-merge, accepted bytes never purged).
